# miniz

miniz 3.0.2, commit `293d4db1b7d0ffee9756d035b9ac6f7431ef8492`, from [richgel999/miniz](https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/293d4db1b7d0ffee9756d035b9ac6f7431ef8492).

The firmware uses the low-level DEFLATE inflater with caller-owned buffers. Compression, archive, stdio and allocation APIs are disabled. `miniz_export.h` supplies an empty export annotation for the static firmware image. The upstream license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
